messages:
natalie: FYI - new model delivery from partner landed in S3. Need intake + prioritization for bring-up. Artifacts path: s3://redwood-models/incoming/prime-omega-8b/2026-03-19/

samir: grabbing details. checksum? did they attach tokenizer?

natalie: included weights.tar.gz + tokenizer.zip + vocab.json. uploader included manifest + PGP sig. Quick manifest snippet:
```
weights: weights.tar.gz
tokenizer: tokenizer.zip
vocab: vocab.json
sha256: 3b7e9f1a2b4c6d7890e5f2a3b4c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f567890abcdef12345678
pgp: prime-omega-8b.sig
```

harpreet: can we run a smoke: load -> generate 16 tokens -> compare logits with reference bundle? if max diff > 1e-3 flag for deeper debugging. Also need model dims (d_model/n_head).

ingest-bot: ledger entry created: ledger_id=ingest-2145000123, registry_path=/models/prime-omega-8b/2026-03-19, status=PENDING

samir: pin to intake queue: priority=medium. Triage checklist: provenance, checksum, tokenizer compatibility, quant-friendliness. Assign @harpreet for quant experiments, @leah for tokenizer sanity.

leah: I can run tokenizer compatibility checks (vocab overlap, special tokens, merges). ETA ~4h. Will post quick diffs.

harpreet: quant plan sketch: produce int8(dynamic) and q4_0 baseline. Use our dalgorithm toolchain. Bench on g5x2. Need model config file to compile kernels.

natalie: config located at s3://redwood-models/incoming/prime-omega-8b/2026-03-19/prime-omega-8b.json - includes d_model/n_head/seq_len. Partner also supplied a lockfile (lockfile.json.gz) that claims exact byte offsets for shards. Capture in provenance.

samir: ops note - ensure S3 objects encrypted with CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/project-redwood-1 and record key ARN in ledger entry. Also verify multipart etags for weights shards.

ml-sre: lifecycle tags to add: ingest=prime-omega-8b, team=eng-ml, priority=medium. If quant quality regressions appear, escalate to eng-ml-oncall and open a regression ticket.

leah: tokenizer smoke output: "Hello world" -> token ids [154, 6, 9], detokenize-> "Hello world". Special tokens present:  token_id=50256. No immediate mismatch. Will run corpus tokenization next.

harpreet: perf smoke: single-token latency ~48ms on g5x2 with batch=1, context=8k. Throughput and mem profile attached later. Need to run long-context perf to validate KV cache scaling.

natalie: action items (short):
1) checksum verify & manifest integrity (samir)
2) persist manifest + lockfile into registry with provenance record (samir)
3) tokenizer validation + corpus tokenization (leah)
4) quant baselines + perf on g5x2 (harpreet)
5) create eval set (100 prompts) and run quality baseline, capture metrics in ledger (natalie)

samir: ack. I'll update ledger status -> IN_REVIEW when checks pass and attach checksum log snippet.

natalie: please also add 'quantability' label in registry metadata (values: likely/unknown/unfriendly) based on harpreet's runs.

harpreet: will annotate after q4_0 run. If output divergence > 0.5% on eval set, mark as 'unknown' and schedule full 8-bit experiments.

leah: uploading tokenizer diffs to s3://redwood-models/internal/tokenizer-checks/prime-omega-8b/ — will link once done.

ingest-bot: ledger update: ledger_id=ingest-2145000123 status=IN_REVIEW metadata_added=[kms_arn,manifest,lockfile,initial_checks]

natalie: thanks everyone. Ping here if you hit blockers. If anything looks like a provenance gap (missing signature or mismatch), escalate and hold the model for security review. :rocket:
